audit_note: 32 audited findings. Reviewer verdicts: ChatGPT MAJOR (5 BLOCKERs, 8 MAJORs, 6 MINORs), Grok MINOR, Gemini MINOR. Post-audit: CONDITIONAL ACCEPT after P1-P5 closes. FALSIFIED 3 (F5 GR-degradation citation, F7 parameter-free language, F16 r_t notation, F21 BF framing, F26 Heinrich 2024 year). No fatal scientific errors. Core forecast architecture sound. Key gaps: title-vs-recast framing, cubic-transfer caveat absent from abstract, birefringence paragraph persistence, Zenodo code DOI missing.

findings.summary: Cai/Li factor-of-two closure not demonstrated by equation-by-equation mapping
Polynomial null-space scatter is basis-dependent, not physical uncertainty; abstract overstates ±0.13
r≈0.84 is shape-grid average not a full SPHEREx bispectrum estimator covariance response
3-5σ headline not derived from joint marginalized Fisher; budget additive in quadrature only
GR-degradation parameterization not supported by cited paper — Jolicoeur 2025 explicitly maps 10-30% range
Title says 'Forecasts' but analysis is a sensitivity recast; body uses 'recast' language throughout
Parameter-free language used without qualification — abstract uses 'minimally parameterized' not 'parameter-free'
Bayes factors too prior-dominated for current prominence
Cubic-order bispectrum transfer caveat (assumption d, linear order only) absent from abstract
Heinrich citation Fig.6/Table 3 locator precision and 0.73 vs 0.7 rounding minor unresolved items
Anomaly-tracer QSO shot-noise caveat absent — fully disclosed in L427-428
Joint (fNL, n_fNL) SDB section too long — editorial preference
Birefringence/ALP section non-load-bearing; GEM-n1 deferred but not excised
Abstract 67 lines, single paragraph; deferred but acknowledged
Fig. 5 sign convention — |fNL|=35/8 vs minus sign in title
Notation overload r/r_t — r_t already defined throughout to avoid collision
Reference formatting — Ref [27] incomplete; Jolicoeur bib author list corrected
Code/data permanence — mutable GitHub branch, no Zenodo DOI
First-to-our-knowledge template-mismatch claim: literature search mentioned but no artifact
Two distinct Fisher analyses need one-sentence cross-reference in §IV; abstract lacks disambiguation
Bayes-factor abstract framing BF~10-17 recommended baseline already in abstract as requested
Factor-of-two distinction between operator algebra and c-normalization should appear earlier
Fig. 2 bar annotations should explicitly label r=0.84 template-overlap inclusion
bφ 20% prior optimistic — quantified degradation to σ≈0.9-1.0 not in body
Correction notes should be consolidated — deliberate transparency policy
Heinrich 2023 references should be 2024 — bibkey maps to PRD 109 (2024) correctly
Fisher shift-invariance near non-zero fiducial fNL=-4.375 — bound acknowledged but not quantified
Null-space coefficient scan uses basis-dependent uniform measure without microphysical bounds
Fermion suppression bound — assumption (f) verbal not quantitative OOM estimate
Lensing magnification SDB vs bispectrum channel separation not quantified at MegaMapper z>2
Monomial basis transformation from Cai to author basis not explicitly shown
c' vs c1-c6 notation confusion — c'≡κ_ε/8 not clearly distinguished from monomial coefficients
